info.title: T12 Dashboard aggregation — APPROVED CONTRACT
info.description: Approved T12 contract, implemented as one additive GET. This one-path contract is not the full runtime OpenAPI; use docs/api/t12_openapi.json. Existing45operations unchanged; runtime total46. All examples are synthetic fixtures, not actual data.

get.summary: Read-only aggregation with explicit units/cohort/UTC semantics
get.description: Secured viewer/operator only. Local remains explicit unauthenticated demo. Cross-field rules in docs/t12_dashboard_api_design.md. No inference/write/migration/registry/promotion or event-time/causal forecast. No request body; nonempty body400.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC date. Both dates or neither; default last30 UTC calendar days including today.

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Exclusive UTC date;1..366days; no later than tomorrow UTC. Effective data capped at as_of.

parameters.description: Task-scoped catalog version; unknown version404, no fallback/promotion.

403.description: Secured access denied; no ownership expansion

DashboardWorkspaceBearer.description: Only when secured profile enabled. Existing shared workspace credential, not a new login/issuer.

DashboardRecordCounts.description: Rows, not customers; total=linked+unlinked. excluded_unlinked is outside total.

DashboardCoverage.description: Linked latest-result customers and missing-result customers; sum equals cohort.customers.

artifact_sha256.description: Expected pinned checksum, not a newly executed prediction.
Expected pinned checksum, not a newly executed prediction.
